## Loading packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
# Prior draws from models/ar.stan and models/arr2.stan across lag orders.
# Requires the `prior_only` flag added to both models.
#
# Drop in notebooks/ar/ and source().

## ---- reference series ---------------------------------------------------
## Y is still passed in: ARR2 uses var(Y) in its transform, and both models
## take sigma_sd = sd(Y). The likelihood is switched off, nothing else is.

umich <- read.csv("../../data/raw/sca-table1-on-2026-Aug-30.csv")
Y <- umich$Index

## ---- compile once -------------------------------------------------------

mod_ar   <- cmdstan_model("models/ar.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))
mod_arr2 <- cmdstan_model("models/arr2.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))

## ---- stationarity check -------------------------------------------------
## Same idiom as the top of ar-notebook.qmd: roots of 1 - phi_1 z - ... - phi_p z^p
## must lie outside the unit circle.

is_stationary <- function(ph) {
  if (any(!is.finite(ph))) return(NA)
  all(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -ph))) > 1)
}

minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) * (1 / (1:p)^2)

## ---- configurations -----------------------------------------------------

p_grid <- c(3, 10, 15)

configs <- list(
  list(label = "naive (sd = 1)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 1.0)),
  list(label = "naive (sd = 0.5)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 0.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 0.60 flat", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p), mean_R2 = 0.60, prec_R2 = 10.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 0.60 Minn.", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p), mean_R2 = 0.60, prec_R2 = 10.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 0.33 Minn.", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p), mean_R2 = 1/3, prec_R2 = 3))
)

## ---- run ----------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

draws_list <- list()

results <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {

    stan_data <- c(
      list(T = length(Y), Y = Y, p = p,
           sigma_sd = sd(Y), prior_only = 1L),
      cfg$data(p)
    )

    fit <- cfg$model$sample(
      data            = stan_data,
      chains          = 4,
      iter_warmup     = 1000,
      iter_sampling   = 2500,
      refresh         = 0,
      show_messages   = FALSE,
      show_exceptions = FALSE
    )

    phi_draws <- fit$draws("phi", format = "draws_matrix")
    stat      <- apply(phi_draws, 1, is_stationary)

    diag <- fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)

    draws_list[[paste(cfg$label, p)]] <<- tibble(
      config = cfg$label, p = p,
      draw = seq_along(stat), stationary = stat,
      max_mod = apply(phi_draws, 1, function(ph)
        if (any(!is.finite(ph))) NA_real_ else max(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -ph)))))
    )

    n_ok <- sum(!is.na(stat))
    p_stat <- mean(stat, na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble(
      config      = cfg$label,
      p           = p,
      n_draws     = length(stat),
      n_finite    = n_ok,
      prop_stat   = p_stat,
      mcse        = sqrt(p_stat * (1 - p_stat) / n_ok),
      divergences = sum(diag$num_divergent),
      max_rhat    = max(fit$summary("phi")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
})

all_draws <- bind_rows(draws_list)

print(results %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))), n = Inf)

write_csv(results, "results/prior_stationarity.csv")
write_csv(all_draws, "results/prior_draws_stationary.csv")

## ---- plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

p_plot <- results %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, prop_stat, color = config)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = prop_stat - 2 * mcse,
                      ymax = prop_stat + 2 * mcse)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "Proportion of prior draws stationary",
       color = NULL, title = "Stationary prior mass by lag order") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("figures/prior_stationarity.png", p_plot, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)

p_plot
```
